# Document Model

## Rules
- `DocumentNode` represents textual non-code resource with unique `path`, project-root-relative `projectRelativePath`, SHA-256 `contentHash`, raw searchable `content`, owning `workspace`.
- Project-global files discovered through `graph.includePaths` outside workspace `codeRoot` use reserved identity `root:<project-relative-path>` and workspace `root`.
- Unknown-adapter file becomes `DocumentNode` only when textual; binary input creates no node.
- Filesystem-backed repository `specsPath` directories are excluded from file/document discovery; spec artifacts enter only through spec indexing.
- Graph search treats documents as first-class filterable category.

## Constraints
- Documents produce no symbols or structural code relations by default.
- `DocumentNode.path` cannot collide with `FileNode.path` in same workspace.
- Normal workspaces cannot use reserved name `root`.
- Workspace-owned physical file never duplicates as `root:`.
